Addendum/Corrigendum No.NPSC/ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) dt. 15.07.2026 (Combined Technical Services Examination 2026) 
 Published on : 15-07-2026 04:23 pm 
 NAGALAND
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) Dated, Kohima, the 15th J uly 2026 
 Addendum/Corrigendum 
 With reference to the
Nagaland Public Service Commission Advertisement No. NPSC-2/CTSE-2026 dated 25 th 
June 2026 and Addendum/Corrigendum dated 10 th July 2026 the
following Addendum/Corrigendum shall be made. 
 Item No.20: (d) 1 (one) post of Vocational Instructor (Plumber) Grade
-III under Labour & Employment,
Skill Development & Entrepreneurship 
 Department . (R eserved
for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland) 
 (e) 1 (one) post of Vocational Instructor Engineering Drawing Grade -III under Labour
& Employment, Skill Development & Entrepreneurship Department . (R eserved for
Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland) 
 (f) 2 (two) post of Vocational Instructor Wood Work Technician Grade -III under Labour & Employment, Skill Development & Entrepreneurship Department . (1 post reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of
Nagaland, 1 post reserved for B.T. Khiamniungan ) 
 Essential
Educational Qualification: 
 Item No.20 : (d)
 Matriculate with National Trade Certificate or
National Apprenticeship Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational
Training in Plumbing or Apprenticeship in Industrial concern for a period of
not less than 3 years or Diploma in appropriate branch. 
 (e) Matriculate with National Trade Certificate or National Apprenticeship
Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational Training in Engineering
Drawing or Apprenticeship in Industrial concern for a period of not less than 3
years or Diploma in appropriate branch. 
 (f) Matriculate with National Trade Certificate or
National Apprenticeship Certificate issued by National Council for Vocational
Training in Wood
Work Technician or Apprenticeship in
Industrial concern for a period of not less than 3 years or Diploma in
appropriate branch. 
 Elective
subjects to be opted and Pay Matrix
/level: 
 Item No. 
 Elective
 subject(s) 
 Level 
 20(d) 
 Plumbing
 8 
 20(e) 
 Engineering Drawing 
 8 
 20(f) 
 Wood
 Work Technician 
 8 
 Note: 
 1. Candidates possessing
 Bachelors
Degree in Science (General) are also
eligible to apply for Item No. 2 : Assistant Conservator of Forests . 
 2. Candidates possessing Diploma/Degree
in Electronics & Communication Engineering are
eligible to apply Item No.7(e) : Junior
Engineer (MIS) 
 3. OTR (One Time Registration) will be active from 12:00 noon 
 of 16 th July,2026 till
12:00 noon of 20 th July, 2026 .
O nline Exam Application Form can be
submitted at the NPSC portal i.e https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in which 
will be available from 16 th 
July, 2026 12:00 till 12:00 Noon of 22 nd July, 2026. 
 ( NUNGSANGMENLA 
 IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission
